name: 봉인의 오르빈
body_structure: 거대한 황금빛 뿔과 빛나는 문양이 새겨진 맹수형
eyes: 눈동자 없이 빛나는 밝은 에메랄드색 안광
wings: 등 뒤로 퍼지는 6개의 빛나는 마법 문양 날개
outfit: 황금 장식으로 덮인 백색의 성스러운 갑주
weapon: 빛의 파동을 방출하는 거대한 황금 낫
silhouette: 거대한 층층 뿔, 6개의 날개 형태의 문양, 거대한 낫, 휘날리는 긴 꼬리
signature_motion: 주변을 크게 베어 넘기는 광역 공격
visual_en: A massive, multi-layered golden horn rises from a head with glowing emerald eyes and flowing white mane. Six radiant, patterned light wings spread from the back of a deep teal beastly body, accompanied by six floating golden seal stones. The creature wears ornate white and gold armor, with an emerald-patterned glow seeping through the cracks. A long tail trailing bright particles sweeps the ground. A giant, heavy golden scythe is held firmly, casting a strong radiant aura of bright emerald and gold, making the silhouette unmistakable even in darkness.
pose_en: Standing majestically while preparing a wide-sweeping slash.
vfx_en: A massive, expanding emerald-colored shockwave bursting from the ground.
lore: 보스 공통 패턴에 더해 6.5초마다 주변을 크게 베는 광역 공격을 한다.

anim_notes.skill: firing a barrage of glowing bullets outward
anim_notes.ultimate: slamming a glowing warning circle onto the ground and summoning minions
anim_notes.vfx: a glowing red warning circle on the ground
anim_notes.attack: a huge sweeping slash all around its body
